positions.title: Senior Technical Advisor - Software Engineering
positions.description:
• Successfully managed a team of 10 software engineers, providing mentorship, guidance, and support to ensure high productivity and quality of work.
• Conducted regular performance evaluations, identified areas for improvement, and implemented training programs resulting in a 60% increase in team efficiency.
• Led efforts to optimize website speed, reducing loading times by 50% and enhancing user experience, resulting in higher user engagement and increased customer satisfaction.
• Implemented SEO best practices, resulting in a 25% increase in organic traffic and improved search engine rankings.
• Chaired and facilitated meetings with cross-functional teams to align project objectives, discuss progress, and resolve issues, ensuring seamless collaboration and timely project delivery.
• Developed and implemented key features that enhanced the platform's functionality and user experience, earning recognition from upper management for outstanding contributions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop dynamic user interfaces within an agile environment, utilizing Angular, Typescript, and React to enhance user experiences in tandem with back-end REST API development
• Research and explore prospective solutions for automated code conversion, encompassing both AI-driven and non-AI methodologies.
• Develop and maintain the API server backend infrastructure leveraging Docker, Maven, and Postman.

positions.title: Senior Financial Analyst
positions.description:
• Served as the subject matter expert (SME) in financial analysis, providing training and guidance to a team of 5 employees, resulting in improved overall performance of 98% and skill development.
• Reviewed and analyzed financial documents, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements, to provide insights and recommendations for loan forgiveness.
• Leveraged advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, and macros, to streamline financial reporting processes and create dynamic, visually appealing reports.
